A '''limousine'''<ref name="Aldhani AD">{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> or '''limospeeder'''<ref name="DoR">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref>, or '''limo'''<ref name="Aldhani AD" /> was a longer-than-usual [[airspeeder]]. [[Mon Mothma]] made use of a [[JPP-192 limospeeder]] during her travels on [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Aldhani" />
